coverage_notes: Section 15 contains operative arbitration, informal-resolution, settlement-conference, fee-allocation, individual-proceeding, batching, severability, and equitable-relief rules. These cannot be faithfully represented with the supplied activities and objects without mischaracterizing dispute-resolution procedures as licensee actions such as Use or ProvideNetworkService.

Section 15.2 requires Customer to complete the Informal Dispute Resolution Form and OpenAI to notify Customer at the Account email address; it also requires both Parties to attend an individual settlement conference if either requests one during the 60-day informal-resolution period. The form is not supplied.

The arbitration-provider rules governing administrative and arbitrator costs are incorporated but not supplied. The batch threshold is 25 or more claimants represented by the same or similar counsel filing substantially similar disputes within 90 days; batches generally comprise up to 50 claimants, subject to the stated fewer-than-50 exception.

paragraph_audit.reason: Lines 86–93 impose operative dispute-resolution procedures and restrictions, including arbitration, informal-resolution steps, exceptions, class-action waivers, batch arbitration, and severability. The allowed activities and objects do not represent these procedures, so encoding them as Use or another activity would be inaccurate. No faithful clauses can be emitted.
